description: We do not have to suffer to live a great life #suffering #selflovejourney #designyourlife
transcript: I am not hard on myself. I treat myself extremely delicately. I do not feel like I have to suffer in order to be successful. I don't feel like I need to suffer in order to pivot and make it to the other side. Actually, suffering is removed from my equation because I do not have to suffer in order to learn. I am extremely gentle with me and I am maneuvering through this life in ease and gentleness and flexibility. I do not have to live a hard life. I do not have to put myself in positions where I am being squeezed to capacity or have nothing to give to myself. I go easy on me because I am inherently ambitious and it is a hard life when your brain is always moving a million miles per hour. I go easy on me.
